items.title: Chat backend initialization failure activates hardcoded financial mock responses
items.affected_baseline: current workspace HEAD 98c111b plus working tree
evidence: frontend/src/views/ChatCopilotView.vue imports chatMock, sets fallbackMode=true on session initialization failure, and calls _sendMock
frontend/src/mocks/chatMock.js contains hardcoded prices, news, reports and watchlist success
items.expected: Backend/auth/session failure displays an error or retry state and never fabricates research data or action success.
items.observed: Static code path routes subsequent messages to hardcoded mock responses.
items.user_impact: Invite users can mistake demo content and simulated writes for real research or account state.
items.security_or_data_risk: High integrity risk; breaks approved-source fail-closed behavior.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Remove production Chat mock fallback/import and render explicit unavailable/retry; retain mocks only in test/dev injection.
items.required_authorization: E1 code change and later browser acceptance
acceptance_tests: theme query never renders mock news

items.title: Current workspace Nginx sends /api/v2 and /health to SPA fallback
evidence: frontend/nginx.conf at HEAD proxies only location ^~ /api/v1/ and uses try_files /index.html for location /
historical phase7e_p1_3 observed public HTML 200
items.expected: All API paths retain backend status/content type and /health is not SPA HTML.
items.observed: Static current config cannot proxy /api/v2 or /health.
items.user_impact: A build from current workspace would break Company V2 API access.
items.reproduction_status: STATIC_CONFIRMED; historical runtime confirmed on fdcdc264
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Do not reimplement: adopt/review the existing proxy fix from commit 184dcadb.

items.title: Working tree is not a releasable baseline and mixes six historical modifications
evidence: 6 tracked changes and 141 pre-audit untracked files
tracked changes include Dockerfile, dependency manifest/lock, startup DB pool warmup and embedding provider
items.expected: E1 begins from a named clean commit and preserves unrelated work.
items.observed: Current branch HEAD is 98c111b while later candidate objects are separate; working tree contains unrelated edits.
items.user_impact: Accidental scope contamination or unverifiable release artifacts.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Create E1 from an explicitly selected clean candidate in a new worktree; do not stage current changes.
items.required_authorization: Owner baseline selection; no destructive Git operation

items.title: Synchronous Chat status completed is not equivalent to research fulfilled
evidence: send_chat_message returns status=completed whenever handler finishes
research fulfillment is optional metadata
stored history and SSE use separate status shapes
items.expected: Public result contract separates execution terminal state from answer fulfillment.
items.observed: The API exposes completed alongside optional/absent fulfillment and reason_code.
items.user_impact: UI may display successful completion for partial/unavailable research unless every path applies separate metadata correctly.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Add a backward-compatible public result adapter shared by sync, SSE terminal event and history serialization.
items.required_authorization: E1 contract decision; migration only if historical normalized fields must be persisted

items.title: Chat send contract has no client_request_id idempotency field
evidence: ChatMessageSendRequest only contains content and output_language
frontend send wrappers send no client_request_id
items.expected: A retried message can be correlated and deduplicated across HTTP/SSE.
items.observed: No request-level client idempotency contract is present in current message schema.
items.user_impact: Network retries may create duplicate messages or research runs.
items.security_or_data_risk: Duplicate side effects if a write-capable path is involved.
items.reproduction_status: STATIC_CONFIRMED; duplicate runtime not reproduced in E0
items.suggested_minimal_fix: First reproduce retry behavior; then add compatible client_request_id/request_id mapping using existing message metadata or a minimal uniqueness strategy.
items.required_authorization: E1 reproduction; migration review if DB uniqueness is required
acceptance_tests: same request retry creates one logical turn
different payload with same key rejected

items.title: Quarterly history availability is not established
evidence: phase7e_p1_3 reported 000725 quarterly DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE
items.expected: Quarterly request returns data or a clear limited-coverage state.
items.observed: Historical runtime returned no data for one audited symbol.
items.user_impact: Users cannot rely on quarterly coverage.
items.security_or_data_risk: Low security risk; medium data completeness risk.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Keep beta promise limited; reproduce with approved account/data before scheduling backfill.
items.required_authorization: runtime reproduction; separate data job approval if backfill

items.title: Report RAG runtime and underlying files are not established for beta
items.affected_baseline: reported production fdcdc264 plus unverified later clues
evidence: phase7e_p1_3 reported report_rag=false and embedding provider mock
six indexed documents/1721 chunks were historical DB facts
prompt-provided six missing file references could not be located in an authoritative current report during E0
items.expected: Selected report PDF exists, matches metadata, is parsed/indexed, and citations resolve.
items.observed: Historical runtime disabled; external-file completeness remains unverified.
items.user_impact: Finding a report title can be mistaken for completed filing analysis.
items.security_or_data_risk: Cross-report or unsupported-answer risk if enabled without evidence.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Keep closed; separately inventory report file existence and index/report selection before any UX promise.
items.required_authorization: read-only file/index audit and later controlled runtime test
acceptance_tests: title vs file vs parsed vs indexed states

items.title: Phase 8 persistent Chat watchlist action is candidate-only and production prerequisites are absent
items.affected_baseline: c197e19 and 9d05b077 candidates; not current workspace
evidence: candidate introduces s7/t8 migrations and action routes
Phase8J.1 historical report says production ledger tables absent and feature off
Phase8K candidate defaults global flag off and allowlist empty
items.expected: Feature remains unavailable until migrations, least-privilege connection, backup evidence and scoped enablement are independently approved.
items.observed: Local isolated candidate exists; no production-ready evidence is combined into this E0 audit.
items.user_impact: No Chat write action in beta; existing REST watchlist remains separate.
items.security_or_data_risk: High if enabled without role/migration controls.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: No E1 implementation; keep capability closed and exclude buttons/promises from beta.
items.required_authorization: separate code release, backup, role change, migration and feature enablement approvals

items.title: Production scheduler and freshness evidence is stale or absent
evidence: phase7e_p1_3 reported no application timer/cron and an old coverage snapshot
items.expected: Each beta data capability has last-success and freshness evidence.
items.observed: Historical audit could not establish an active refresh scheduler.
items.user_impact: Data may be stale despite routes being available.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Do not add a scheduler in E1; display as-of and inventory existing jobs before any separate operations phase.

items.title: SSE disconnect, sync fallback and session switching may diverge
evidence: frontend falls back from SSE to synchronous POST
current request has no client_request_id
session guards exist but E0 did not execute browser tests
items.expected: One user turn produces one persisted result and old session responses cannot update a new session.
items.user_impact: Potential duplicates or stale UI after network/session changes.
items.security_or_data_risk: Cross-session UI integrity risk; no cross-user incident established.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Reproduce with real production page controller and mocked network before deciding schema changes.
acceptance_tests: SSE response lost then sync fallback

items.title: Migration portability and extension compatibility require candidate-specific revalidation
evidence: historical artifacts describe earlier pgvector/standard PostgreSQL migration failures and later remediation
E0 did not run migrations
items.expected: Selected release chain upgrades from actual production head on the target PostgreSQL capability set.
items.observed: No current migration execution in E0 by design.
items.user_impact: Potential deployment block, not a confirmed runtime product bug.
items.suggested_minimal_fix: Do not change migration in E1 unless the selected clean baseline reproduces the issue; run isolated upgrade matrix in a separately authorized phase.
